messages:
Marta K (Finance): Heads-up — Soteria invoice INV-98321 is currently on HOLD in Coupa. No approver matched on our side. Can someone take a quick look? @Ajay R
Ajay R: Looking now. Import shows no PO number in the structured field. Vendor PDF has a PO on the doc but the EDI/PO field is empty, so the system didn't pick it up.
Marta K (Finance): We did get an email with PO-7819 attached, but I think vendor_id in the feed is SOT-OLD and our supplier table expects SOT-NEW (migration in Jan). That might explain routing.
FinanceBot: Auto-hold triggered for INV-98321. Reason: missing_po_field; vendor_id mismatch. Invoice moved to HOLD queue.
Leo T: If vendor id doesn't match, the routing falls back to the default procurement route which is currently a dead group address. Need supplier mapping corrected.
Soteria AP: Sorry about the trouble — we attached the PO on the PDF but our EDI didn't populate the PO field. Link to PDF: https://files.soteria.example/INV-98321.pdf. PO printed on page 1 as PO-7819. We can resend.
Marta K (Finance): Two options: vendor re-issue with PO in the EDI/PO field (preferred), or we do a manual PO match on our side. Manual match creates extra GL noise but quicker.
Ajay R: Short-term I'll perform a manual PO match and route to @Leo T for approval so payment can proceed. Long-term procurement needs to update supplier mapping from SOT-OLD -> SOT-NEW. @procurement-ptl can you confirm?
Leo T: Thanks. When you match, please validate line items map to contract code 320. If quantities or amounts don't match the PO we should open a dispute with Soteria before payment.
FinanceBot: Action logged: Manual PO match executed by Ajay R. Invoice status changed to "Pending Approver".
Soteria AP: We'll resend with the PO in the EDI/PO field by EOD. Apologies — internal mapping issue on our side.
Marta K (Finance): Great — @Ajay R, once you get the EDI-resend or after manual approval, please finalize payment. This is one-off due to the migration; no need to escalate if numbers line up. :pray:
Ajay R: On it. I'll match now and aim to push payment on next run if @Leo T approves. Will update thread with confirmation or if any discrepancy arises.
